lead.claim: SPECT-CT may complement other imaging in chronic low back pain.
lead.context: This study explored how SPECT-CT findings relate to MRI and CT results in patients with chronic low back pain.

supporting.claim: Knee surgery setting may affect re-injury risk and PT duration.
supporting.context: This study compared injury rates and physical therapy duration for U.S. Army soldiers after knee surgery in military versus non-military facilities.

supporting.claim: Consider aquatic exercise to help older adults prevent falls.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This feasibility study of Aqua Steps found it reduced falls and improved functional and strength tests for older adults at high fall risk.

supporting.claim: Support patients with SCI in redeveloping their occupational identity.
supporting.context: This qualitative study explored how individuals experience changes in their occupational identity after spinal cord injury.
